title: Channel-Market Fit & Distribution Decisions
description: Practice evaluating channel strategies, interpreting distribution metrics, and making partnership tradeoffs under realistic business constraints.

interactions.prompt: A B2B SaaS startup reports: Direct sales CAC $1,200 (LTV:CAC 4.2x), Partner channel CAC $680 (LTV:CAC 3.1x), Content/inbound CAC $310 (LTV:CAC 6.8x). Inbound drives 15% of total pipeline. What's the key insight?

options.text: Partner channel is most efficient due to lowest CAC
Inbound is most efficient but severely constrained by volume
Direct sales should be cut immediately
All three channels are performing above benchmark

chartData.title: CAC and LTV:CAC Ratio by Channel

interactions.prompt: You're launching a developer tools product. You can either invest in a self-serve PLG motion with usage-based pricing, or sign an exclusive distribution deal with AWS Marketplace that guarantees visibility but takes a 20% revenue share. Your runway is 14 months.

options.text: Go PLG—own the relationship, keep margins, iterate faster
Take the AWS deal—instant distribution to enterprise buyers
Launch PLG now, negotiate a non-exclusive AWS deal later
Split budget 50/50 across both channels simultaneously

interactions.prompt: When a channel's CAC rises faster than its contribution to LTV, the channel is experiencing ____, signaling it may be approaching saturation.

options.text: Diminishing marginal channel returns
Channel conflict escalation
Distribution disintermediation
Negative network effects

interactions.prompt: A DTC skincare brand expanding into retail wants to evaluate potential channel partners. Rank these criteria from most to least important for channel-market fit: (a) Partner's margin requirements, (b) Overlap with target customer demographic, (c) Partner's co-marketing budget, (d) Speed to shelf availability.

options.text: Partner's margin requirements
Overlap with target customer demographic
Partner's co-marketing budget
Speed to shelf availability

interactions.prompt: Shopify reports that merchants using 3+ sales channels see 190% higher revenue than single-channel merchants. However, merchants adding their 4th+ channel see only 12% incremental lift. What does this tell a GTM strategist?

options.text: Every merchant should maximize total channel count
Multi-channel matters but returns plateau sharply after three channels
The data is misleading due to survivorship bias alone
Single-channel merchants should switch rather than add channels

chartData.title: Revenue Lift by Number of Sales Channels

interactions.prompt: Your B2B fintech product sells through reseller partners who own the customer relationship. A major enterprise client wants to buy direct at 30% higher ACV. Taking the deal risks alienating your top partner who referred the lead. What do you do?

options.text: Take the direct deal—revenue and relationship ownership matter most
Honor the partner channel and pass the deal through them
Negotiate a hybrid: direct contract with partner referral commission
Create a formal channel conflict policy before deciding

interactions.prompt: A Series B HR tech company is entering the European market for the first time. Rank these channel strategies from highest to lowest priority: (a) Hire a direct sales team in London, (b) Partner with local HR consultancies as resellers, (c) Launch a localized self-serve free trial, (d) Sign an OEM deal with SAP SuccessFactors.

options.text: Hire a direct sales team in London
Partner with local HR consultancies as resellers
Launch a localized self-serve free trial
Sign an OEM deal with SAP SuccessFactors

interactions.prompt: Your top reseller partner (40% of revenue) just got acquired by a competitor. They'll honor existing contracts for 90 days but won't renew. You have a growing but immature direct sales team and two smaller partners. What's your immediate priority?

options.text: Accelerate direct sales hiring and ramp aggressively
Immediately contact all partner-sourced customers to migrate relationships
Double down on the two smaller partners with better economics
Launch an emergency PLG motion to reduce channel dependency

interactions.priorContext: Previously you relied heavily on a reseller-led channel strategy with one dominant partner driving 40% of revenue. Now that partner has been acquired by a competitor, creating an urgent 90-day window before losing access to those customer relationships entirely.
